description: Four weeks of what happened in a city, sorted by kind, for one category. roads (default): crashes, stalled vehicles, hazards and debris, closures, vehicle fires. power: outages by size (one home, small, neighborhood, large), planned outages, downed or sparking lines. transit: delays, canceled trips, reduced service, detours, stop and station changes, planned work. roadwork: lane, ramp and full road closures. water: main breaks and leaks, outages and shutoffs, boil water advisories. Reports that did not say are counted as Type not given. With the busiest and quietest hours of the week, each day of the week's average (by_weekday, busiest_weekday) and each hour of the day's average (by_hour, busiest_time), the full hour-of-the-week grid (hour_grid) and a count for every day (daily), how many new ones a typical instance of an hour sees (pass hour_of_week, or it uses the current hour in the city), the median time until it ended by kind, the places with the most, and for roads how much of the road they took. Use for 'what kind of incidents does Atlanta get', 'when are crashes worst in Dallas', 'how long do Houston power outages last', 'is transit worse on Mondays in Chicago', 'which day of the week has the most incidents', 'what time of day is worst', 'how much night roadwork does Seattle do'. Compare cities by mix and timing, never raw totals: what each city's reports cover differs. Cite it as the CitySignal Index and give page_url.

category.description: roads (default), power, transit, roadwork or water.
